description: Your meter-account statement, live: month-to-date metered Reads counted at the published tariff, your watched topics with billing/billing status and their acceptance evidence, and your daily cap. Requires your identified key on the request (x-api-key header, or authorization: Bearer sb_live_...). Without a key this tool explains how to get one — every read surface stays available in the free anonymous lanes either way. Recognition is opt-in via credential: no key, no tracking.
name: get_account
